items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the exceptional divisor of the blowup in the rational situation is a proper Cohen-Macaulay curve with very ample twist of degree at least one, with equality only when the base is regular, with vanishing first cohomology and with sections of the twists identified with the successive quotients of the powers of the maximal ideal (statement lines 2580-2594). The proof (proof lines 2595-2615) uses very ampleness, normality, the comparison sequences of powers of the ideal sheaf, and a degree computation. H3: five assertions proved together from several inputs.
